children: The FTSE MIB rose to around 52,000 on Thursday, extending gains from the previous session and tracking moves across regional peers.

Markets digested the Federal Reserve’s expected 25-bps rate hike and signal of at least one more increase this year, as its continued focus on containing inflation helped bolster confidence in the central bank’s policy stance.
Easing bond yields and softer oil prices provided additional support to market sentiment.
At the sector level, luxury names outperformed, with Moncler and Brunello Cucinelli advancing more than 2%.
Other notable gainers included Fincantieri (+1.9%), Leonardo (+0.7%) and Stellantis (+2%).
Most heavyweight financials also traded higher.
On the flipside, STMicroelectronics slipped more than 1%.

title: FTSE MIB Extends Gains
